create_WSDSchedule: create a WSDSchedule optimizer with warmup, constant, and linear anneal phases for learning rate control
create_WarmupCosineSchedule: create a WarmupCosineSchedule optimizer with linear warmup followed by cosine decay for learning rate scheduling
create_CosineWDSchedule: create a CosineWDSchedule optimizer that applies cosine decay to weight decay values over training steps
create_LinearDecaySchedule: create a LinearDecaySchedule optimizer that linearly decays learning rate from reference to final value over T_max steps
test_scheduler_step: test the step method of any scheduler class to verify it updates optimizer parameter groups correctly
